Route: /admin/products (popup) · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• Checks on Save, each shown under its field and focusing the first problem: name required; price ₱0.00 or more; cost blank or ₱0.00 or more; prep time whole minutes 0–120; a recipe with
• “Calculate from recipe” (POST /api/nutrition/estimate): each raw material's grams per serving ÷ 100 × its values per 100 g (set in 14d), added up. Raw materials without nutrition, or
pieces without a weight, are left out and named.

g.text: Optional. Without a photo, the kiosk shows the icon. JPEG, PNG
or WebP; it's made smaller before uploading.
For one serving. Use 0 for items served as they are, like bottled drinks.
Orders use it to estimate when they'll be ready.
Raw materials used by one serving. The dish's stock is the servings
these can make: paying for an order deducts them, and the dish shows
as sold out when they can't make another serving.
Per serving: Raw material 150 g, Raw material 1 pc
Quick options customers can tap, sent to the kitchen with the order.
Customers can also type a note.
